description: Source code for archive-related commands in a Git implementation, including functions for creating output files, running remote archivers, and the main command handler 'cmd_archive'.

methods.name: create_output_file
methods.description: Creates or truncates an output file and redirects stdout to it.

methods.name: run_remote_archiver
methods.description: Sets up a remote transport connection, sends arguments, and reads the archive data.

methods.name: cmd_archive
methods.description: Main command function to handle archive creation, either locally or remotely.
